 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. WILSON ISIDOR will make his second European start of the season after Regis Le Bris named a strong Sunderland starting side for this evening's Europa League game with Dinamo Zagreb.
 Le Bris has made six changes from the team that started last weekend's Premier League defeat at Coventry City, with Isidor getting the nod to start in attack ahead of Timur Tutierov, with Brian Brobbey rested.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Sunderland in Europe - in association with Costspex Opticians (Image: The Northern Echo) 
 Thomas Meunier and Dayann Methalie return in the full-back positions, replacing Trai Hume and Reinildo Mandava, with Omar Alderete partnering Kevin Danso at centre-half.
 Alderete will serve a domestic suspension at the weekend following his sending off in the defeat at Coventry, but is able to play in Europe.
 Granit Xhaka remains at the heart of midfield, but finds himself playing alongside Jules Ahoka, who has impressed in his European outings so far this season, with Noah Sadiki left out of the starting XI.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nilson Angulo and Malick Fofana fill the wide-attacking positions, with Chris Rigg expected to play in a central attacking-midfield role behind Isidor.
 SUNDERLAND (4-2-3-1): Roefs; Meunier, Danso, Alderete, Methalie; Xhaka, Ahoka; Angulo, Rigg, Fofana; Isidor. 
 Subs: Moore, O'Nien, Jen Jones, Hume, Reinildo, Sadiki, Le Fee, Talbi, Brobbey, Tutierov, Whittaker, Proctor.
